said

components · 0.4.1 · C4 · aj-c-said

The product's note beside an entry: shut until opened (details/summary, no script). The label column says "From your record"; opening rolls the label from "Read the note" to "Hide the note", turns the chevron and lets the note down. The note ends in the citation pair.
